---
name: Suggest a source
about: A board, aggregator or contracting platform that belongs here and is missing
title: "[add] "
labels: addition
---

**Name and link**

Link to the page a job seeker should actually land on, not a marketing homepage if a listings page exists. No affiliate links, referral codes or tracking parameters.

**What it actually is**

One or two plain sentences. What it carries, who it is for, and any gate. Please skip the marketing language: "the leading platform for ambitious professionals" tells a reader nothing.

**Does it expose a free feed or API?**

If yes, the endpoint. If no, say what the gate is: paid, login required, approved profile, affiliate-only.

**How did you verify it?**

The most important field. "I opened it and saw Solutions Engineer roles in LATAM" is worth ten suggestions that say "adding X, it is good."

**Which section does it belong in?**

If you are not sure, say so and leave it to the review.
